samples.xml_description:
<module id="synchronizer">
    <description>Implement a multi-bit MUX-based synchronizer. The input data will remain constant during the period when data_en is high, and data_en is high for at least 3 clk_b clock cycles. When the value of data_en is high, data can be synchronized. The data change frequency of data_in is very low. The change interval between two adjacent data is at least 10 clk_b clock cycles. clk_a is responsible for data_in and data_en, while clk_b is responsible for data_en delays two cycles, that is, two D flip-flops. Output refers to clk_b.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk_a">Clock signal A.</input>
        <input id="clk_b">Clock signal B.</input>
        <input id="arstn">Active-low reset signal A.</input>
        <input id="brstn">Active-low reset signal B.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[3:0]">Input data signal.</input>
        <input id="data_en">Input enable signal.</input>
        <output id="dataout" width_description="[3:0]">Output data signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="data_reg">Register to store input data.</parameter>
        <parameter id="en_data_reg">Register to store enable data.</parameter>
        <parameter id="en_clap_one">Control register 1.</parameter>
        <parameter id="en_clap_two">Control register 2.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <line>Stores input data.</line>
        <line>Updated on positive edge of clk_a or negative edge of arstn.</line>
        <line>Reset to 0 when arstn is low.</line>
        <line>Updated with data_in when arstn is high.</line>
        <line>Width is 4 bits.</line>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description>
        <line>Stores enable data.</line>
        <line>Updated on positive edge of clk_a or negative edge of arstn.</line>
        <line>Reset to 0 when arstn is low.</line>
        <line>Updated with data_en when arstn is high.</line>
        <line>Width is 4 bits.</line>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description>
        <line>Control registers for data_en.</line>
        <line>Updated on positive edge of clk_b or negative edge of brstn.</line>
        <line>Reset to 0 when brstn is low.</line>
        <line>Updated with en_data_reg when brstn is high.</line>
        <line>Width is 4 bits.</line>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description>
        <line>Output data is assigned on positive edge of clk_b or negative edge of brstn.</line>
        <line>Reset to 0 when brstn is low.</line>
        <line>Assigned with data_reg when brstn is high and en_clap_two is active.</line>
        <line>Otherwise, dataout retains its previous value.</line>
        <line>Width is 4 bits.</line>
    </logic_description>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        <line>Register data_reg stores input data data_in.</line>
        <line>It is updated on the positive edge of clk_a or the negative edge of arstn.</line>
        <line>When arstn is low, data_reg is set to 0.</line>
        <line>When arstn is high, data_reg is updated with data_in.</line>
        <line>Register en_data_reg stores input enable signal data_en.</line>
        <line>It is updated on the positive edge of clk_a or the negative edge of arstn.</line>
        <line>When arstn is low, en_data_reg is set to 0.</line>
        <line>When arstn is high, en_data_reg is updated with data_en.</line>
        <line>Register en_clap_one and en_clap_two control the selection of input data.</line>
        <line>They are updated on the positive edge of clk_b or the negative edge of brstn.</line>
        <line>When brstn is low, both en_clap_one and en_clap_two are set to 0.</line>
        <line>When brstn is high, en_clap_one is updated with en_data_reg, and en_clap_two is updated with en_clap_one.</line>
        <line>Output dataout is assigned on the positive edge of clk_b or the negative edge of brstn.</line>
        <line>When brstn is low, dataout is set to 0.</line>
        <line>When brstn is high, if en_clap_two is active, dataout is updated with data_reg.</line>
        <line>Otherwise, dataout retains its previous value.</line>
    </implementation>
</module>
